channel.title: Ys Goldt Journal
channel.description: Journal entries and photographs by Ys Goldt.

item.title: The Illusion of Stagnation
item.description: On the quiet changes we rarely notice, and the ways we are always becoming something new.

item.title: A Place for Thoughts to Live
item.description: I have been thinking for some time about keeping a journal. I always wanted somewhere for my thoughts to exist outside of myself and so I decided to create one, which is what you see here.

item.title: The Things I Give My Characters to Hold
item.description: My father has no grave. My uncle has no grave. A friend I lost years ago has no grave.
